# Sidecar Vending Services

> Sidecar Vending Services installs, stocks, monitors, and maintains smart vending
> machines at no cost to businesses across North Metro Atlanta. Locally owned and
> operated by Vala Renfroe and Brian Morris.

Service model: free installation, free stocking, free maintenance and repairs.
No capital outlay, no rental fees, no monthly charges. Revenue comes from product sales.

Machines: AI-powered smart vending coolers with touchscreens and cashless
payment (Apple Pay, Google Pay, tap-to-pay cards).

Service area: North Metro Atlanta. See the Service Area page for the full list of
covered zip codes and an interactive map.

Industries: offices and coworking, warehouses and industrial, apartment communities,
gyms and fitness studios, medical and healthcare, auto dealerships.

Contact: (470) 839-3656 - https://sidecarservices.com/#evaluation

## Key pages

- [How It Works](https://sidecarservices.com/how-it-works): The 3-step process from free evaluation to installed machine.
- [What It Costs](https://sidecarservices.com/cost): Why the service is free to the host business and what's included.
- [FAQ](https://sidecarservices.com/faq): Answers on contracts, cost, space requirements, and service response times.
- [Service Area](https://sidecarservices.com/service-area): Covered zip codes with an interactive map.
- [Switching Vendors](https://sidecarservices.com/switching-vending-companies): How to replace an existing vending provider.
- [Industries](https://sidecarservices.com/industries): Vending programs by industry.
- [Support](https://sidecarservices.com/support): Contact an existing customer's account team.
